records.verificationNote: Losartan potassium 50 mg tablet read at PDF p.42 (Renin-Angiotensin-Aldosterone System Inhibitors): Tier 1, no flags. Valsartan read at p.43, Tier 1, no flags. Combination products (losartan-HCTZ p.42, valsartan-HCTZ p.43) excluded from single-agent alternatives. Sacubitril-valsartan (Entresto, p.42, Tier 1) is heart-failure use and out of this class's scope. Irbesartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, candesartan and azilsartan do not appear in this document; not all-inclusive. Document says: "Kaiser Foundation Health Plan does not have a requirement for PA" (PDF p.6) and "does not have a requirement for Step Therapy" (PDF p.7). Drugs not listed are nonformulary; when a Kaiser or referral doctor determines one is medically appropriate and necessary it is covered by formulary exception (PDF p.7; decision within 72 hours, 24 urgent, PDF p.8). Completeness is ambiguous: p.6 defines the formulary as "the complete list of prescription drugs preferred for use and eligible for coverage" but p.2 says "not an all-inclusive list", so absence is not treated as exclusion. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: policy wording corrected; 5 named absent drug(s) added as nonformulary (exception route)]
